text.p: Here are highlights of stories in the Romanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament decided to create special fund to guarantee bank deposits.
- Trade union at the state television threatened to launch strike if wages in the sector, affected by inflation, are not adjusted.
- Prices for fuel will remain unchanged in March, the National Oil Company said.
- Authorities set limits to fuel shipments to the Clisura Dunarii area, near the border with Serbia, to prevent fuel smuggling to Serbia.
- Parliament decided to support companies which create new jobs.
- Tractorul Brasov SA tractor plant will be split into eight production units, the paper said.
- Bancorex SA foreign trade bank and the National Oil Company (CRP) signed accord for a credit worth $500 million, needed by CRP to finance its crude oil imports in 1997.
- Roman Autocamioane SA truck maker will increase by 45 percent the prices for its products.
